lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The highest intensity maxima are concentrated in the mid-lateral region, with inter-blob spacing increasing slightly toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement where blobs serve as anchor nodes within the lighter vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadowing on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant mechanical trauma visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, manifested as a jagged, irregular truncation and a distinct V-shaped notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
